product_overview: Sitio web institucional y carta digital para Sánchez & Sánchez, una pizzería y cafetería de barrio. Permite explorar la marca, revisar menús navegables y acceder rápidamente a canales externos de pedido y contacto.
core_goals: Conocer la identidad, historia y ubicación del local.
Explorar la carta digital de pizzería por categorías y ver detalles de los productos.
Consultar el menú del día y seleccionar la opción de cada jornada.
Descubrir productos de cafetería mediante un acordeón de secciones y un carrusel de novedades.
Acceder a canales externos de pedido y contacto como WhatsApp, Mercado Pago, Rappi, PedidosYa, teléfono, redes y mapa.

features.name: Navegación hamburguesa móvil
features.description: Menú de navegación a pantalla completa disponible en las tres páginas para moverse entre secciones y páginas del sitio.
user_flows: Navigate to /estilo-floria/ -> Tap the hamburger icon -> See the full-screen navigation overlay -> Tap a destination link -> Navigate to the chosen page or section -> See the menu close automatically

Navigate to /estilo-floria/carta/ -> Tap the hamburger icon -> See the full-screen navigation overlay -> Tap a destination link -> Navigate to the chosen page or section -> See the menu close automatically

Navigate to /estilo-floria/cafeteria/ -> Tap the hamburger icon -> See the full-screen navigation overlay -> Tap a destination link -> Navigate to the chosen page or section -> See the menu close automatically
Navigate to /estilo-floria/ -> Tap the hamburger icon -> See the full-screen navigation overlay -> Tap the hamburger icon again -> See the menu close without navigating

features.name: Acciones rápidas del hero
features.description: Botones de acceso directo desde el hero de la Home para ir a la carta, la cafetería y secciones internas de la página.
user_flows: Navigate to /estilo-floria/ -> Tap the button for the carta -> Navigate to /estilo-floria/carta/
Navigate to /estilo-floria/ -> Tap the button for cafetería -> Navigate to /estilo-floria/cafeteria/
Navigate to /estilo-floria/ -> Tap the button for menú del día -> Smooth-scroll to the menu del día section
Navigate to /estilo-floria/ -> Tap the button for delivery -> Smooth-scroll to the delivery section

features.name: Selector de menú del día
features.description: Sección de la Home que muestra el menú correspondiente a cada día laboral y adapta la vista automáticamente según la fecha actual.
user_flows: Navigate to /estilo-floria/#menudeldia -> Observe the current weekday selected automatically -> See that day's menu list
Navigate to /estilo-floria/#menudeldia -> Tap a weekday button -> See the menu list update to that day
Navigate to /estilo-floria/#menudeldia -> Visit the page on Saturday or Sunday -> See the weekend notice message

features.name: Enlaces de delivery y pedido
features.description: Tarjetas de acceso externo para pedir o abrir plataformas de entrega desde cualquier página del sitio, más accesos rápidos en la barra fija móvil.
user_flows: Navigate to /estilo-floria/#delivery -> Tap the WhatsApp card -> Open a pre-filled WhatsApp chat in a new tab
Navigate to /estilo-floria/#delivery -> Tap the Mercado Pago card -> Open the payment platform in a new tab
Navigate to /estilo-floria/#delivery -> Tap the Rappi card -> Open the delivery platform in a new tab
Navigate to /estilo-floria/#delivery -> Tap the PedidosYa card -> Open the delivery platform in a new tab
Navigate to /estilo-floria/ -> Use the mobile sticky bar to open the menu or start a WhatsApp order

features.name: Carta digital con pestañas fijas y desplazamiento sincronizado
features.description: Vista principal de la carta de pizzería con pestañas por categoría que llevan al usuario a la sección correspondiente y se resaltan según la parte visible de la página.
user_flows: Navigate to /estilo-floria/carta/ -> Tap the category tab for comidas -> Smooth-scroll to the comidas section
Navigate to /estilo-floria/carta/ -> Tap the category tab for pizzas -> Smooth-scroll to the pizzas section
Navigate to /estilo-floria/carta/ -> Tap the category tab for empanadas -> Smooth-scroll to the empanadas section
Navigate to /estilo-floria/carta/ -> Scroll through the page -> See the active tab update to match the section in view

features.name: Tarjetas de producto y modal de detalle
features.description: Grillas de productos de la carta que permiten abrir un modal con imagen, descripción completa y precio, incluyendo precios chica/grande en pizzas.
user_flows: Navigate to /estilo-floria/carta/ -> Tap a product card -> See the detail modal open with image, name, description and price
Navigate to /estilo-floria/carta/ -> Tap a pizza product card -> See the detail modal open with chica and grande pricing
Navigate to /estilo-floria/carta/ -> Open a product modal -> Close it by tapping the backdrop or the close control -> Return to the product grid
Navigate to /estilo-floria/carta/ -> Open a product modal -> Press Escape -> Close the modal and return to the product grid

features.name: Carrusel de productos nuevos de cafetería
features.description: Carrusel horizontal de novedades de cafetería que se mueve automáticamente y también puede navegarse manualmente.
user_flows: Navigate to /estilo-floria/cafeteria/ -> Observe the products carousel moving automatically -> See the next featured product appear in sequence
Navigate to /estilo-floria/cafeteria/ -> Tap the right arrow control -> Move to the next product
Navigate to /estilo-floria/cafeteria/ -> Tap the left arrow control -> Move to the previous product
Navigate to /estilo-floria/cafeteria/ -> Drag the carousel sideways -> Manually browse the products
Navigate to /estilo-floria/cafeteria/ -> Hover the carousel on desktop -> See the auto-scroll pause

features.name: Acordeón de categorías de cafetería
features.description: Secciones colapsables para organizar el menú de cafetería por categorías, con la sección de promos abierta por defecto.
user_flows: Navigate to /estilo-floria/cafeteria/ -> Observe that Promos is expanded by default -> See the items in the first section
Navigate to /estilo-floria/cafeteria/ -> Tap a category header -> Expand the category items
Navigate to /estilo-floria/cafeteria/ -> Tap the same category header again -> Collapse the category items
Navigate to /estilo-floria/cafeteria/ -> Focus a category header and use Enter or Space -> Toggle the section open or closed

features.name: Contacto, ubicación y mapa embebido
features.description: Bloque de contacto disponible en las tres páginas con dirección, horario, teléfono, redes sociales y mapa de Google embebido.
user_flows: Navigate to /estilo-floria/ -> Scroll to the contact section -> Tap the phone number -> Start a phone call on mobile
Navigate to /estilo-floria/ -> Scroll to the contact section -> Tap an Instagram or TikTok icon -> Open the social profile in a new tab
Navigate to /estilo-floria/ -> Scroll to the contact section -> Interact with the embedded map -> View the location inside Google Maps
Navigate to /estilo-floria/carta/ -> Scroll to the contact section -> Tap the phone number or social links -> Open the corresponding contact destination

tech_stack: Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+, no build tools, no bundler)
Static site (no backend, no API, external links only for delivery)

routes.description: Home page - hero, brand story, menu del dia, reviews, delivery links, location, contact
Full pizzeria menu with category tabs, product cards with modal detail, delivery links, contact
Cafeteria menu as accordion sections, new products slider, delivery links, contact

features.name: Mobile hamburger navigation menu
features.description: Full-screen overlay nav menu toggled by a hamburger button, present on all three pages, with body scroll lock while open
user_interactions: Tap hamburger icon to open the full-screen menu
Tap a nav link (Home, Carta, Cafeteria, Delivery, Ubicacion) to navigate or scroll to a section
Menu closes automatically after tapping a link
Tap hamburger icon again to close without navigating

features.name: Hero call-to-action buttons
features.description: Four buttons in the Home hero section linking to Carta, Cafeteria, and in-page anchors for Menu del Dia and Delivery
user_interactions: Tap "Ver la Carta" to navigate to the Carta page
Tap "Cafeteria" to navigate to the Cafeteria page
Tap "Menu del Dia" to smooth-scroll to the Menu del Dia section
Tap "Delivery" to smooth-scroll to the Delivery section

features.name: Menu del Dia day selector
features.description: Tab-style buttons for Monday through Friday that swap the visible list of dishes for that day; auto-selects the current weekday on load and shows a weekend notice on Saturday/Sunday
user_interactions: Tap a day button (Lunes..Viernes) to reveal that day's menu list
Observe automatic selection matching today's date
See a weekend notice message when visiting on Saturday or Sunday

features.name: Delivery and ordering links
features.description: Four external link cards (WhatsApp, Mercado Pago, Rappi, PedidosYa) present on all three pages plus a persistent mobile sticky bar with quick links to the menu and WhatsApp
user_interactions: Tap the WhatsApp card to open a pre-filled WhatsApp chat in a new tab
Tap Mercado Pago / Rappi / PedidosYa cards to open the respective ordering platform in a new tab
On mobile, tap the sticky bottom bar buttons (view menu / order via WhatsApp)

features.name: Sticky category tabs with scroll-spy
features.description: On the Carta page, a sticky tab bar (Comidas, Pizzas, Empanadas) that smooth-scrolls to the matching section and highlights the tab whose section is currently in view
user_interactions: Tap a category tab to smooth-scroll to that menu section
Scroll the page manually and observe the active tab update and auto-center in the tab strip

features.name: Product card and detail modal
features.description: Grid of tappable product cards (food, pizza, empanada) across multiple categories; tapping a card opens a modal with a larger image (when available), full description, and price, including dual Chica/Grande pricing for pizzas
user_interactions: Tap any product card to open its detail modal
View image (or no image for products without a photo yet), name, description and price in the modal
Close the modal via the close (X) button, by tapping the dark backdrop, or by pressing Escape
Tab through the modal to confirm focus stays trapped inside while open

features.name: Draggable auto-scrolling product slider (Cafeteria "Productos nuevos")
features.description: Continuously auto-scrolling horizontal carousel of upcoming cafeteria products that also supports manual navigation via arrow buttons or by dragging/swiping with a finger or mouse
user_interactions: Observe the slider auto-scrolling continuously in a seamless loop
Tap the left/right arrow buttons to move one item at a time
Press and drag (mouse) or touch-and-swipe (mobile) the slider left or right to scroll it manually
Hover the slider (desktop) to pause auto-scroll

features.name: Accordion menu categories (Cafeteria)
features.description: Collapsible sections for each cafeteria category (Promos, Cafes e Infusiones, Especiales, Bebidas, Tortas, Panaderia, Waffles, Tostados); Promos is the first section and the only one open by default
user_interactions: Tap a section header to expand or collapse its item list
Confirm only "Promos - Todo el Dia" is expanded on initial page load
Use keyboard (Enter/Space) on a focused header to toggle it, confirming aria-expanded updates
Expanding a section smooth-scrolls it into view

features.name: Location and contact section with embedded map
features.description: Address, hours, phone (tel: link), social links, and an embedded Google Maps iframe, present on all three pages
user_interactions: Tap the phone number to trigger a phone call on mobile
Tap Instagram/TikTok icons to open social profiles in a new tab
Interact with the embedded Google Maps iframe

known_limitations.issue: Promos para compartir slider on the Carta page is commented out/disabled
known_limitations.impact: The promo slider markup and its JS/CSS hooks exist but render nothing until real promo photos are added and the block is uncommented

known_limitations.issue: 9 products have no photo yet (Fugazza, Cuatro Quesos, Queso Brie, Parma, Queso Azul Argentino, Vegetariana, Calabresa, Pollo Deshuesado, Pollo Argentino)
known_limitations.impact: Their product cards render as text-only (no image box) and their modal also hides the image area; this is expected/intentional until photos are supplied
All "ordering" is done via external links (WhatsApp/Mercado Pago/Rappi/PedidosYa); nothing is stored or processed on this site itself
